_doc: Pipeline settings. One record per diffusion LM. 'base' is its autoregressive origin (for CKA); null = trained from scratch (the control).
_n_test: 1319 = full GSM8K test. Lower it (e.g. 500) to cut generation time; record the value used.
_n_shots: The anchor paper evaluates math with 4-shot prompts (sec 4.4).
_models: Decoding settings follow each model's own recommended sampler, so they differ between models -- a stated confound. Dream: alg MUST be 'entropy' (its default 'origin' is random-order decoding). LLaDA: block_length is forced = gen_tokens (smaller values switch on semi-autoregressive decoding); temperature > 0 is required for N distinct candidates (its default 0 makes all N identical).
_scorers: Small AR scorers for reranking (idea 1.1 names GPT-2 and TinyLlama). Run in a process WITHOUT attention_patch -- see score_candidates.py.
